Name: Shipping Collection Sorted By Mods
Author: holythesea
Description:
As a heavy mod user that has probably dozens of JA mods installed, I have added a lot of items to my game that I need to ship for perfection. But it's always bugged me that all of the items end up jumbled together in my collections tab because it makes it really hard for me to go through systematically and see which items from which mods I still need to make.

So I made this mod to [b]re-organize the shipping collection so that modded items will show up together in their packs[/b] as opposed to haphazardly strewn about! Sorting can be toggled on and off with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (no keybind).﻿

[b]Note[/b]: it does readjust the sorting of the vanilla items as well a bit, but I assume that if you're downloading this then you're not worried about those anyway (: Items added via DGA will also simply be tacked onto the end of the menu.

As always, a really big thank you to the SDV Modding Discord community for all of their wisdom, help, and friendship <3 I am available there on the SDV discord for any questions.
